gatherCatchClauseCommentText(...) implements dual-position behavior: - If beforeText already contains @story or @req, it returns beforeText directly (REQ-POSITION-PRIORITY). - Otherwise, if sourceCode.getCommentsInside exists, it collects comment values from node.body and returns their joined text when present (inside-catch detection; REQ-DUAL-POSITION-DETECTION, REQ-FALLBACK-LOGIC). -
